newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana stock exchange ends slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: Ghana stock exchange ends slightly firmer.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange ended the week marginally higher after another quiet session, dealers said.
The Ghana All-Share Index added 0.42 point to 383.43.
Ghana Commercial Bank recovered 10 cedis of its recent loss, ending at 520, on turnover of 35,000 shares, and Pioneer Tobacco added five to 305.
The most active stock was Enterprise Insurance, which ended five cedis higher at 555 with 180,100 shares changing hands.
Among the losers, Ashanti Goldfields fell 400 cedis to 21,600.
Overall volume was a low 375,790 shares. -- Abidjan newsroom, +225 21 90 90
